name: rounded-plate
why: Rounded corners authored in section. Closed form 5(800 - 9(4 - pi)) = 3961.372 mm3; exact B-rep 3961.371669 (STEP probe), 4 cylinders + 6 planes, 10 faces. A quarter-cylinder corner here is the same surface an .edges('|Z').fillet(3) would make, built without a rolling ball.
